explanation: T'(t)=⟨-sin(t),-cos(t)⟩, so T'(π)=⟨0,1⟩ and ‖T'(π)‖=1. Thus the curvature is κ=‖T'(π)‖/‖r'(π)‖=1/π, giving radius ρ=π. The principal unit normal is N(π)=⟨0,1⟩, so the center is P+ρN=(-1,-π)+π⟨0,1⟩=(-1,0).

answers.correct_value: The center is $(-1,0)$ and the radius is $\pi $
answers.wrong_value: The center is $(-1,-2\pi )$ and the radius is $\pi $
